name: agentic-bioflow-v2
description: Seqera Platform as the execution backend for Nextflow/nf-core, plus the two things Seqera cannot do for a firewalled HPC: round resource requests up to the cluster's QOS floor, and reach the internet from compute nodes. This repo is itself the marketplace.

plugins.name: agentic-bioflow
plugins.description: Five commands: three mirroring Seqera's own object model - setup (compute environment), launch (pipeline/dataset/launch), runs (monitor, debug, deliver) - plus downstream (figures from a finished run) and finish (a package that can be submitted).
